prompt: One loop step that adds four floats at a time from two arrays into a third.
template:
movups xmm0, [rdi + rax*4]
    movups xmm1, [rsi + rax*4]
    {{0}} xmm0, xmm1
    movups [rdx + rax*4], xmm0
    add rax, {{1}}
explain: `addps` adds four packed single-precision floats at once; `addss` would add only one. The index counts floats, so four are consumed per step. Index scaling by 4 already converts floats to bytes.
